description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineOrder_Merge" sourceRef="Start_OnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneOrder_Merge" sourceRef="Start_PhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_GenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmation_PickAndPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateLabel_HandOver" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandOver_SendTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendTracking_Monitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Delivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="End_SuccessfulDelivery"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PostDeliveryActions" name="Post-delivery customer actions" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ActOnFeedback" name="Take further action on customer feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackAction" name="Feedback action complete"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Return" name="Return received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ActOnReturn" name="Take further action on return"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnAction" name="Return action complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Action" sourceRef="Start_CustomerFeedback" targetRef="Task_ActOnFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_ActOnFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Action" sourceRef="Start_Return" targetRef="Task_ActOnReturn"/>

  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfilment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderFulfilment" name="Order fulfilment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfilment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PostDeliveryActions" name="Post-delivery customer actions" processRef="Process_PostDeliveryActions"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OnlineOrder" name="Online order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OnlineOrder" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_PhoneOrder" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
